decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording rev4-02 and the selected primary color treatment; no additional state change is required.
Selecting the primary color treatment does not determine or change which alternative color variants must be delivered.
The selected color treatment changes presentation but does not alter the business name, excluded term, or strapline wording.
The primary color selection concerns the final logo and does not change the already completed obligation to provide initial concepts.
Choosing a primary color treatment does not alter the requirement that the logo artwork be fresh and original.
